items.title: The standard simplicial object of an adjoint pair is simplicial with an augmentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-standard-simplicial at source lines 6891-6898: in the standing situation of an adjoint pair, the system X = (X_n, face maps, degeneracy maps) built from alternating composites of the unit and counit is a simplicial object of the functor category, and the first counit defines an augmentation from X to the constant simplicial object at the identity functor. The proof at source lines 6900-6937 is a verification of the simplicial identities, which in this situation are concrete computations with unit-counit composites. The two identities checked are the face-degeneracy one and the middle face-degeneracy one, and in each case the proof reduces the claim to an equality of two composites of the unit with itself, which holds because both sides are the same expression. Recognising which composite reduces to which standard identity is the substance, and the statement mentions none of the identities. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
